answer: Buying flax, running a loft for a year and paying 14,200 is what a fake bolt costs, and the forgery still fails at the first harbour. Each bolt of sail canvas is stamped at the sail loft with its length and its weave, and the loft ledger holds the stamp of every bolt sold. A shale sail sewn from unmarked canvas fails the ledger: at the quill of the cloth the weave must match the bolt the stamp names, and unmarked canvas has no story, while the signal stamp on the sail is read at every harbour.
